correctness.rationale: The exact rank and overlap transition is obtained by counting all partial bijections and direct hypergeometric intersection. Local complex-uniform Perron Laguerre asymptotics establish the Gaussian factors and the single-factor mean constant. Hypergeometric conditional falling-factorial moments together with tightness and a fixed-number induction establish mutually independent Poisson correction coordinates, independent of the Gaussian factors. The exact expected-rank recurrence is elementary conditioning. An independently constructed actual-composition verifier matched exact integer two-dimensional histograms in eight exhaustive finite configurations; finite verification is supplementary rather than a universal proof.

Broad random-semigroup convolution literature and uninspected equivalent formulations remain an explicit publication-priority risk. value.rationale: The rank of a product is a canonical operation-sensitive statistic in a finite inverse monoid. The exact transition yields the full finite distribution at every product length without explicit enumeration of all tuples, while the joint limit isolates a genuine Poisson-order overlap correction independent of n-quarter-scale Gaussian rank fluctuations. The fixed-length second-order expected-rank constant reveals overlap quantitatively. These statements classify natural distributions over an infinite algebra family, not a contrived finite census or a bare restatement of one-factor counts.
